description:
Type de projet: Marketplace web
Public cible: Collectionneurs sérieux
But: Permettre aux utilisateurs de soumettre et vendre des cartes sportives via un système de "razes".

Fonctionnalités clés:
- Système de "razes" (enchères/loterie)
- Soumission de cartes par les utilisateurs
- Paiements par e-transfer
- Messagerie entre utilisateurs
- Tirages au sort aléatoires certifiés et transparents

Design & marque:
- Ambiance: Moderne, prestigieux, léger
- Palette de couleurs: Légère (ex: blanc, gris clair, couleur d'accent), choix final laissé au designer.

Intégrations & extras:
- Notifications (email/SMS) pour le début des "razes" et les résultats.

designManifest.iconDirection: A flat emblem mark: a circular gold certification seal enclosing a stylized card slab silhouette, on the pale paper ground — engraved-house feel, no text.
designManifest.signatureMove: A running auction-catalogue 'lot' system: each raze is a graded-slab card stamped with a gold wax-seal certification mark, a 'Lot N' tag and a live countdown, with thin gold hairlines dividing every section like a printed sale ledger.
designManifest.summary: An auction-catalogue identity where every sports card is a numbered, sealed lot on a bright champagne-paper floor — the excitement of the draw framed by the credibility of a certified house.
designManifest.typography: Bodoni Moda (high-contrast didone display, auction catalogue) paired with Hanken Grotesk (clean humanist grotesque body)

promptHistory.changeNotes:
Initial build of RAZZ·UP, a bilingual (FR/EN) premium sports-card marketplace with a certified 'razes' (auction/lottery) system. Includes a live raze board, raze detail with e-transfer entry flow, verified seller profiles + reviews, a certified-draws transparency page with public SHA-256 proofs, winners wall, card submission flow, peer-to-peer messaging, user account dashboard, news, and a contact form. A background cron auto-activates upcoming razes and runs certified random draws at close, notifying winners. Full self-contained admin backend (dashboard + shared shell modules for razes, submissions, sellers, reviews, winners, posts) with AI image generation and Cloudinary upload, pending e-transfer confirmation, and one-click certified draws.

Admin enrichment pass: (1) Rebuilt the admin module shell (admin-shell.ejs) with clearer module-aware modal titles, prettified human-readable field labels (label||prettified name), required-field markers + client-side validation, richer table rendering with status badges, boolean Oui/— indicators and image thumbnails, an item count in the topbar, a Refresh button, search empty-states distinct from no-data empty-states, friendly empty states with icons, toast notifications replacing all alert() calls, click-outside-to-close modal, and gold-styled AI generate button. CRUD (create/edit/delete) and row actions (draw/approve/reject) remain fully wired to existing API routes — every row stays editable/deletable. (2) Redesigned the dashboard (admin.ejs) with icon stat cards (active raze card accented), a pending-actions alert banner, section title, icon module cards, block headers with warning pill counts, scrollable styled tables, and proper icon empty states; pending e-transfer confirm/delete now give toast feedback. (3) Overhauled admin-styles.css: added --admin-brand var, focus-visible rings on inputs/buttons, toast component, status badge palette, checkbox field styling, table hover/scroll wrappers, alert/pill/empty-state styles, accent stat card, improved modal shadow and mobile behaviour while preserving prior class names. (4) Public CSS: added accessible focus-visible outlines on buttons. No functional data flows, routes, or schema changed; all hardcoded functional collections (razes with pricing/entry length, sellers, etc.) were already admin-manageable and remain so. All {{IMG_*}} placeholder tokens preserved byte-for-byte.
